title: Happy 365 Days to Us! 💖
message: One year ago, I was the luckiest person alive because I had you by my side. Every moment with you has been a blessing, and I cherish every memory we've created together. Here's to many more years of love, laughter, and happiness. Happy 365 Days to us! 💖

timeline.title: First Time We Met
timeline.description: The moment I saw you, I knew you were the one. Your smile lit up the entire room, and I couldn't take my eyes off you.

timeline.title: The day of YES
timeline.description: The day I said yes, it was the happiest day of my life. I am so grateful to have you as my partner, and I look forward to spending the rest of my life with you.
